verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's core interface is a documented public API — the completion() function that mirrors OpenAI's format for 100+ providers, plus a self-hosted Proxy exposing REST endpoints (virtual keys, cost tracking, MCP REST tools/list and tools/call callable via curl) — all backed by first-party docs. However, probes found no discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on standard paths), so machine-readable API contract discovery is weaker than the narrative docs suggest. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/swagger schema, and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness beyond docs.
